```plaintext
Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the__ one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) __assessing the germination potential of__ at least one of said one or more embryos prior to germination.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially __of water or a combination of water and non-harmful additives__.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __gentle sonication and/or a suitable cell wall degrading__ enzyme.

Claim 9 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __isolation and extraction of__ the DNA.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and __evaluating the characteristics of__ the plant.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification __or comparable amplification technique__ is performed.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __the results of the genotyping analysis__.
```
